idea-plugin.name: Twig Block Tree
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the Twig block structure around the caret, like the built-in HTML tag tree highlighting:
  • a colored bar in the gutter for each enclosing Twig block ({% if %}, {% for %}, {% block %}, ...), one color per nesting level;
  • when the caret is on a Twig tag, the other tags of the same block ({% else %}, {% endif %}, ...) are highlighted.
Colors: Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Twig Block Tree.
